main_text.p: μὴν, ὁ δὲ τῷ ἀνδρὶ ματος τὸ ἀξίως γένηται, καὶ ἐν σῶμα, καὶ μία ποίμνη ἐφ᾽ ἑνὶ ποιμένι [?]. Sanctissimi Locumtenentes senioris Romæ dixerunt. Benedictus Deus, quod bona fama sanctissimi Photij Patriarchæ, non tantum in nostram regionem, sed in vniuersum mundum exiuit, non rumore solum firmitatem habens, sed operibus præstitis fines illius complexa; nec solum modo in Italiam & Galliam peruenit, sed in omnem terram, quæ sub sole est, & hoc testantur non tantum, qui linguam callent Græcam, sed barbaræ ipsæ, & efferatissimæ gentes, quod non est similis illi, neque in sapientia, neque in doctrina, neque in erogandis eleemosynis, neque in commiseratione, neque in integritate, & sui ipsius despicientia; & quod semper opera sermones illius excedunt, & numerosiora sint. Dominus noster Apostolicus Imperatoris precibus, & vestris supplicationibus flexus, misit nos minimos, vt una vobiscum Dei Ecclesiam in vnum congregemus, quod mediante Spiritu sancto peractum est, & vnum corpus, & vnus grex sub uno pastore coaluistis. Vin maiora? Πεγοκτὴν ὁ Θεοφιλέστατος Ἀγχιστικόπος Καισαρείας εἶπε. Ἑώσον ἐπαρτὴν ἐπ᾽ ἀληθείας τὸν τῷ σύμπαντος κόσμου τὴν δύναμιν λαχόντα εἰς τύπον τῶν ἀγχοι-[?] μόνου Χρηστοῦ τῷ Θεῷ ἡμῶν. ὁ καὶ ἀναλαβὼν ὁ μακάριος ὑπεζωγράφησε Παῦλος εἰπών· ἔχοντες δὲ αἰτίαν ἀγαθὴν [?] Τολ-μή-

page.notes: The Greek is badly printed and partly faded; words marked [?] are uncertain. The first line is cut off at the top and runs in from the previous page. Lines 2 and 3 of the Greek are the least certain. The Latin is clear. Latin u/v has been normalised to u or v by the rule (e.g. vniuersum to universum is printed as vniuersum; left as the scan shows since the scan uses v for consonant). Section symbols and dots in the left margin are not text.
